* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p5-26-Mara_Jades_Lightsaber.png]]) prints it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 21) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped “its” (“Target hit, and forfeit = 0”)<ref name="cl-1281_25-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-marajadeslightsaber-pre.gif]], undated) prints it.
